summary.intent: Finish CipherBox Phase 69 by executing and merging plan 69-10, which deletes the legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata types now that all live consumers (recycle-bin, vault-creation) have migrated to the node/v3 model.
summary.outcome: Plan 69-10 completed and merged (c40f17acb): legacy folder-model types, decrypt.rs, and related fuse/desktop consumers deleted; full non-winfsp workspace build and test suite passed; residual grep confirmed no live references remain. Phase 69 is now 19/20 merged, with only the Windows-only 69-14/WinFsp plan left, deferred to a Windows machine.

repo: D-04 single-codec doctrine enforced in crates/core: no From<FolderMetadata>/From<FileMetadata>/to_node/from_legacy/into_node adapters exist between legacy and node/v3 types — this is intentional, not a gap.

crates/core::folder::VersionEntry is the one symbol retained from folder.rs after the legacy-type purge; everything else in that file (FolderMetadata, FolderChild, FolderEntry, FilePointer, FileMetadata, encrypt/decrypt helpers) was deleted.
publish_file_node is now the single per-file publish path after crates/fuse/content_ops.rs::publish_file_metadata was deleted.

Windows-only code (platform/windows/operations.rs:272, write_ops.rs:18,983) still calls the now-deleted publish_file_metadata and legacy types — this is expected to stay red until 69-14 fixes it on Windows/winfsp.
workflow: Running `rustfmt` on a crate-root lib.rs recursively reformats the entire module tree, producing large out-of-scope diffs; must `git checkout --` the collateral files to keep commits scoped to the intended change set.

Green-boundary verification for this kind of deletion plan = cargo check --workspace (default features) + cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse + a residual grep excluding winfsp trees and comments — this triad is the standard gate before merging a legacy-type-deletion plan.

winfsp feature build is expected to fail on macOS dev machines (missing windows-future/windows_core::imp::IMarshal deps) since it's CI/Windows-only — a red `--features winfsp` build is not a regression signal here.

friction: First commit in the 69-10 worktree only captured the decrypt.rs deletion because `git add` aborted on an already `git rm`'d pathspec; required a `git commit --amend` to fold in all 4 core changes.
open_items: 69-14/WinFsp is the last remaining Phase 69 plan; must be run on a Windows box to fix the still-present publish_file_metadata callers and legacy-type references in platform/windows/operations.rs and write_ops.rs.
